title: controlplane: add conditional DNS-proxy and service-account rotation with staged rollback hooks
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in strict-network environments require a resilient way to fail DNS resolution for the control plane onto a local proxy when cross-account resolver rules fail, plus a secure, auditable path to rotate the service account used by controlplane endpoints. This PR implements a conditional DNS-proxy sidecar/profile and a service-account rotation operator with staged rollback hooks and preflight checks. Summary of changes: 1) Terraform module (network/controlplane) - add optional 'dns_proxy' submodule that provisions an EC2/EKS-backed ResolverProxy target group, IAM role and security group templates, and route53 conditional forwarding records. The module is guarded by a boolean flag 'enable_dns_proxy' to keep existing installs unchanged. 2) Helm chart (controlplane/values.yaml, templates) - introduce dnsProxy.enabled flag, a Deployment manifest for the dns-proxy with readiness/liveness probes and an init hook that validates resolver propagation. 3) Installer reconcilers - add a new 'sa-rotation' controller that creates a transient service account, rebinds endpoint permissions, and writes rotation events to the audit log. Includes a safe-swap flow: create, test, promote, revoke. 4) Upgrade/rollback tooling - preflight checks for resolver visibility, SG connectivity test, and an automated rollback hook that replays the last known-good endpoint state and re-attaches previous service-account credentials if promotion fails. 5) Tests and docs - integration test harness for the proxy in the 'benchmark-lab' job matrix and docs/upgrade-guide note describing operator behavior and emergency rollback steps. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep behavior unchanged; dns_proxy is opt-in and sa-rotation is gated by a feature flag. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and unit tests - [x] Helm chart templating + values defaulted off - [x] Reconciler unit tests and e2e in CI - [x] Preflight health checks and failure-mode documented - [x] Security review for IAM changes - [x] Release note drafted. Related: ENG-3281 (controlplane resilience), SUP-7421 (customer support ticket complaining about resolver failures).

release_notes: Optional DNS proxy and safe service-account rotation for controlplane deployments. Enable with terraform var 'enable_dns_proxy' and feature flag 'enable_sa_rotation' in the installer. Provides resilient resolver fallback and an auditable sa rotation path with staged rollback. No behavior changes when flags are unset.
